exact_statement:
theorem main :
    ∃ φ : Q3 ≃ Q3, IsHamiltonian φ ∧ (fixedSet φ).encard = 3 ∧
      (3 : ℕ∞) < 4 ∧ 4 ≤ criticalNumber ∧ HasDegenerateFixedPoint φ
